evidence.quote: Meld je aan voor de opleiding via Studielink.

notes: The tuition fee quoted is a general institutional fee for non-EEA students; the programme page does not state a programme-specific fee.

note.fr: Vérifiez si votre diplôme (Baccalauréat marocain) est accepté pour l'admission et si des conditions supplémentaires s'appliquent.
note.en: Check whether your diploma (Moroccan Baccalauréat) is accepted for admission and whether additional conditions apply.

note.fr: Les étudiants de nationalité non-EEE doivent postuler avant le 1er mai et payer les frais de scolarité avant le début de l'année universitaire.
note.en: Non-EEA nationality students are required to apply by May 1st and to pay their tuition fees in full prior to the start of the academic year.

evidence.quote: Students with a non-EEA nationality are required to apply by May 1st and to pay their tuition fees in full prior to the start of the academic year.
